entities.summary: LTT 9779 b, officially named Cuancoá, is a Neptune-sized planet orbiting the sunlike star LTT 9779, or Uúba. As of 2023, it has the highest-known albedo of any planet. It was discovered in 2020 using data from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), and is also called TOI-193 b.
